items.title: Manual KPI snapshot at release
items.description: KPI snapshot was written by hand at each release. Automated via .github/workflows/kpi-snapshot.yml (snapshot_kpis.py) on v* tag push: enforces gate, appends snapshot + deltas, records memory entry, resets status, commits back. Remaining manual seam: project-specific metric fetch into metrics.json (documented in scripts/README.md).
items.proposed_automation: Done. Add a project-specific fetch step that writes metrics.json before the snapshot step for fully-automated values.
items.interest_rate: Resolved; only the per-project metric source remains to wire.

items.title: Metric fetcher lacks a ratio adapter for derived KPIs
items.description: scripts/fetch_metrics.py adapters return a single scalar per source (event count, row count, p75). Ratio/derived KPIs such as activation rate (kpi-001 = activated_users / new_users) cannot be computed from one query, so their values must be supplied manually or carried forward. Affects any rate, conversion, or per-user KPI.
items.proposed_automation: Add a 'ratio' fetch type to fetch_metrics.py that runs numerator + denominator sub-queries (each reusing an existing adapter) and divides. Config shape e.g. instrumentation.fetch: { "type": "ratio", "numerator": {"source":"amplitude","event":"core_action_completed","metric":"uniques"}, "denominator": {"source":"amplitude","event":"signed_up","metric":"uniques"}, "scale": 100 }. Keep the safe-skip contract: omit the KPI if either side is missing. Update entries.md + scripts/README.md, then re-point seed kpi-001 at it. Target v0.2.0.
items.interest_rate: Low until a project relies on a ratio KPI in CI; then it blocks automated tracking for that KPI.
